title: Burnt Sun
description: The Sun is a Extra Deadly Laser.
body:
### Main Idea
Whenever a Entity or Player is out in Daylight (No Blocks above Someone.) They get Damaged (2 Damage (1 Heart)) and Die eventually. (A Person/Entity that is in Water that is in Daylight will still Die)
**A Person will still get Damaged at NightTime.** (Get blame it on the fact that Moon Light is reflected SunLight)

After a Player Spawns a Oak Leaf Block will be placed above their head so they don't die instantly.

### Sun Sickness
**Sun Sickness** happens when you stand out in the sun for too long. (300 ticks default (It is a Gamerule)) 
The Sun Sickness Timer is based on how many ticks a Person has stood in the sun.
You Could see this timer by doing **/BurntSun Stats**
Sun Sickness does:
- -6 from Max Health.
- -1 from Safe Fall Distance.
- Make a Entity/Player take 2x Damage from the Sun (4 Damage (2 Hearts)).
